analyst_view.overall: Early view: AZ, fifth on 23 points, host NEC, 11th on 14. AZ host Sturm Graz in the Europa League on Thursday 10 December, so this Sunday game comes three days later. One report also lists NEC in the Europa League this season, so both sides may come in off a midweek game. One round-up says AZ were recently beaten 5-1 at home by PSV with a very young line-up, a sign that their squad is being stretched.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. AZ's leaky recent form and NEC's run of home games with at least two goals point up, but tired legs from Thursday European games can make for a slower game. I stay with the site's figure.

corners.text: The numbers say 10 corners. Nothing I found on tactics or line-ups moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. There is no rivalry or table pressure that points either way, and the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.4 shots. I lean slightly lower because both teams may rotate after Thursday European games, and AZ have reportedly been fielding very young sides, which tends to lower the tempo.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. I see no news that moves this either way this far out.
